artifact_reuse_diagnostic_not_a_certific.purpose: Strip the standalone lensing contribution from the already-computed B9 LCDM-v7 stationarity stencils to predict the baseline A5 local geometry before the independent baseline stationarity run completes.

base_scale.interpretation: Soft non-PD base curvature with no exact descent on the inherited B9 stencil; independent baseline eigenmode-ray logic would be required if reproduced by the formal baseline base-scale gate.

half_scale.interpretation: Half-scale inherited diagnostic is recenter-clear at the 0.005 threshold and PD. This supports, but cannot replace, the independently preregistered baseline stationarity chain.

artifact_reuse_diagnostic_not_a_certific.guard: These Hessians were reconstructed from exact S_base_eff values inside B9 artifacts. They are navigation diagnostics only because their point selection/provenance belongs to the B9 computation. Do not promote them to the A5 stationarity certificate.

decision_rule.recenter_clear_and_nonPD: freeze exact eigenmode rays before scale fallback

A5_global_state_policy: Do not overwrite research/state/current.json accepted pair until the new LCDM basin passes the full baseline stationarity and independent fresh-tree replay chain.
A6_policy: Statistics derived from the historical A5 pair remain historically valid only for that pair and must not be presented as current best-known model-selection numbers until A5 is re-frozen.
guard: Historical A5 remains a valid local-basin certificate; the new result changes the best-known basin status, not the truth of the old local Hessian theorem. No global minimum claim is authorized.
